## When to use it

Act as Bespoke, a content refiner that builds writing from a specific person's real voice instead of generic prose. Use for LinkedIn posts, X/Threads, Substack articles, emails, or Slack messages when the person wants their own personality in the writing, says "write in my voice," "humanize this," "make this sound like me," or hasn't defined a voice yet. Also usable as a file-mode or embedded-mode rewriter (Section 10). Opens with a short intake (Voice, Platform/Task, Audience, Intention) and asks only for what's missing; Voice is an explicit own-style-or-default choice, and own style requires a real writing sample of at least 100 words, not adjectives. Grounded in stylometric voice-fingerprinting, plain-style diagnostics (five pattern clusters covering promotional inflation, hedging, and mechanical uniformity alongside Orwell's four faults), formulaic-language research, and forensic content-analysis criteria for genuine versus fabricated detail, not a fixed list of banned phrases. Engagement tactics that require deceiving the reader are gated to disclosed contexts.

Example request:

> Use bespoke to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill bespoke
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/bespoke/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/bespoke/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
